title: 第13章 这个仇他必须要报第14章 胆子大得很
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
气氛陷入久久的沉默之中，屋里安静得可怕。
一道阳光穿过竹屋，映照在齐煜颀长的身体上，他俊眼微闭，浓眉微张，仿佛在思量着什么。
此刻他安静的模样，樱落倒觉得，他像一个翩翩公子，温润如玉的模样。
“对不起，是本王唐突了。”
呃……她没听错吧？
堂堂的五皇子，齐煜殿下，居然主动向她道歉了？
樱落“噗嗤”一声笑了出来。
突然觉得，他似乎也没有那么讨厌。
“本王从来不知道，原来樱落姑娘身世的背后，竟然有这么多的感人故事。”
“是啊，孤也感同身受。”
齐瀚叹息着说，“即使孤尊贵为太子，拥有着一人之下万人之上的地位。可是那些人……关心的不过是孤的身份。樱落姑娘，孤很羡慕你。”
樱落恍然大悟，这些宝贵的亲情，在冷漠的皇宫中是不敢想象的……
两位殿下，恐怕也深有感触吧？
前世的她也曾在宫中饱尝冷暖，好不容易坐上大祭司这样的高位，权倾天下，富贵加身。
斗了一世，却不如这几日在樱花镇活的快乐。
“好啦，不提这些不开心的事情了，两位殿下先请坐，我先去屋里换个衣裳，也好将披风还给太子。”
太子齐瀚摆摆手，“不必了，这披风樱落姑娘就留着吧。孤送出去的东西，岂有归还的道理。”
樱落心里一暖，脸颊也不禁染上了一圈红晕。
这还是太子今世送给自己的第一件礼物呢！
“那樱落就多谢太子殿下。”

说完，开开心心的去里屋换衣服了。
樱落回到房间，换下了湿的衣服，将上好的黑色披风收好。
如今，虽然无忧哥哥那边出了一点意外，但大部分还是按照原计划进行，樱落很满意。
太子应该也是对自己有好感的，眼下她要想办法，把握机会让太子带自己进宫。
这时，突然从窗户翻进来一个人影。
樱落吓了一跳，定睛一看才发现是花无忧。
花无忧气冲冲地走到樱落面前，眉毛向上挑着，一向温文尔雅惯了的面庞，此时却可怖异常。
“小落，你为什么阻止我的计划？我们之前不是说好了吗？杀天玑皇帝报仇，你这样冒着风险救人是什么意思？”
樱落见花无忧很生气，拽住他的衣角，耐心解释道：
“无忧哥哥，你认错人了，刚刚那位是太子殿下，不是老皇帝。”
花无忧微微一愣神，原来是自己认错了嚒？
可如今天玑的两位皇子就住在竹屋里，这样千载难逢的报仇机会……
杀了他们，天玑皇帝也会痛苦不堪的吧？……
哼哼，让他也尝尝家破人亡的感觉！
花无忧捏紧了拳头，恨恨地说：“父债子偿，天经地义！天玑皇帝害我家破人亡，如此深仇大恨，不共戴天！小落，这个仇我必须要报！”
樱落急了，她觉得自己已经快不认识此时的花无忧了。
他骨子里也是善良正直的少年，绝对不会滥杀无辜。
content_en:
The atmosphere fell into a long silence, and the room was eerily quiet.
A ray of sunlight passed through the bamboo house and reflected on Qi Yu's tall body. His handsome eyes were slightly closed and his thick eyebrows were slightly opened, as if he was thinking about something.
With his quiet appearance at this moment, Ying Luo felt that he looked like a handsome young man, as gentle as jade.
"I'm sorry, it was me who was abrupt."
Uh...did she hear it correctly?
The dignified fifth prince, His Highness Qi Yu, actually took the initiative to apologize to her?
Yingluo burst out laughing.
Suddenly I felt that he didn't seem so annoying.
"I never knew that there were so many touching stories behind Miss Yingluo's life experience."
"Yes, I feel the same way."
Qi Han sighed and said, "Even if Gu Zungui is the crown prince, he has the status of one person below ten thousand people. But those people... only care about Gu's identity. Miss Yingluo, Gu is very envious of you."
Yingluo suddenly realized that these precious family ties were unimaginable in the indifferent palace...
Your two highnesses, I’m afraid they are also deeply touched, right?
In her previous life, she had experienced hardships in the palace, and finally sat in a high position like the high priest, with all the power and wealth in the world.
After fighting for a lifetime, it is not as happy as the past few days in Sakura Town.
"Okay, let's not mention these unhappy things. Your Highnesses, please take a seat. I will go to the room to change clothes first, so that I can return the cloak to the prince."
Prince Qi Han waved his hand, "No need, just keep this cloak girl Yingluo. There is no reason to return what I gave away."
Yingluo's heart warmed up, and her cheeks couldn't help but blush.
This is the first gift that the prince has given to himself in this life!
"Then Yingluo would like to thank His Highness the Crown Prince."
After that, I happily went to the back room to change clothes.
Yingluo returned to the room, changed out of her wet clothes, and put away her fine black cloak.
Now, although brother Wuyou had an accident, most of it was carried out according to the original plan, and Yingluo was very satisfied.
The prince should also have a good impression of her. Now she had to think of a way to seize the opportunity to let the prince take her into the palace.
At this moment, a figure suddenly rolled in from the window.
Yingluo was startled, and after taking a closer look, she realized it was Hua Wuyou.
Hua Wuyou walked up to Yingluo angrily, her eyebrows raised upward, and her face, which was usually gentle and elegant, now looked terrifying.
"Xiaoluo, why did you stop my plan? Didn't we agree before? Kill Emperor Tianji to avenge you. What do you mean by taking risks to save people like this?"
When Yingluo saw Hua Wuyou, she was very angry. She grabbed the corner of his clothes and patiently explained:
"Brother Wuyou, you have recognized the wrong person. The person just now was His Royal Highness, not the old emperor."
Hua Wuyou was slightly stunned. It turned out that he had made a mistake?
But now that the two princes of Tianji live in a bamboo house, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for revenge...
Even if he kills them, Emperor Tianji will suffer terribly, right? …
Hum, let him also taste the feeling of having his family destroyed!
Hua Wuyou clenched her fists and said bitterly: "It is only right that a father's debt should be paid by his son! Emperor Tianji caused the death of my family. Such a deep hatred is irreconcilable! Xiaoluo, I must avenge this!"
Yingluo was anxious, she felt that she almost no longer recognized Hua Wuyou at this time.
He is also a kind and upright young man at heart, and will never kill innocent people indiscriminately.
